description:
Upstream maps Ctrl+C to `app.clear` (clear the editor text). Exit is Ctrl+D (only when editor is empty). Our Interactive hardcodes Ctrl+C as immediate exit (`%{state | exit: true}`).

This is a significant UX divergence — users expect Ctrl+C to cancel the current input, not kill the entire session.

Change:
- Ctrl+C with non-empty editor: clear the editor text
- Ctrl+C with empty editor while agent is running: abort the agent run
- Ctrl+C with empty editor while idle: no-op (or show a hint about Ctrl+D to exit)
- Ctrl+D with empty editor: exit
- Escape with empty editor: exit (already implemented)

Ref: `interactive-mode.ts` L2178-2326.
title: Interactive: Ctrl+C should clear editor, not exit
